submission.captureHint: Long receipt? Add up to 10 clear close-up photos of the same receipt. Arrange them from top to bottom, with a few overlapping rows. Include the header and total.
submission.limits: Use at most 10 photos, each no larger than 20 MB.
submission.unreadable: The receipt could not be read reliably
submission.returnLater: You can stay here or close this page. Save this link to return later. Pending submissions are also available in Queue; completed receipts appear in Receipts.
submission.loadError: Could not load this submission. Check your connection and that you are signed in to the account that uploaded it.
submission.recovery: An earlier upload has an unknown outcome. Check Queue first. To recover it, select the same photos in the same order and click Upload. Its original options and request key will be reused. No upload is sent automatically.
submission.ownerChanged: Your account changed. Select the photos again before uploading.
submission.allowFallback: Allow vision analysis if OCR fails

upload.title: Upload receipt
upload.supportedTypes: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC
upload.bypassHint: Automatic verification is available only for complete receipts that pass the current checks. Otherwise review is required.
upload.processingBody: The local vision model is extracting the details. This can take a minute.
upload.queuedBody: No vision model is reachable right now. The background worker will analyse the image shortly.

queue.title: Analysis queue
queue.emptyBody: Pending and failed images will appear here.
queue.deleteBody: “{file}” will be removed from the queue and disk.
queue.deleteConflict: This image can no longer be deleted.

receipt.verifyBody: The receipt is marked as verified and its image is moved to permanent storage.
receipt.notFoundBody: This receipt does not exist or was deleted.
receipt.deleteBody: “{merchant}” will be deleted along with its image.
receipt.deleteBlocked: This receipt is used in a benchmark run and can't be deleted.

search.emptyBody: Enter a product name to see past prices and the stores you bought it at. Only verified receipts are searched.

dashboard.emptyBody: Verify a receipt to see it in your dashboard and statistics.

statistics.itemIntro: Your spending trends reflect prices, quantities, and what you chose to buy. They are not an inflation measure.
statistics.itemEmpty: No item spending in this period.
statistics.share: Share of item spending (excluding deposits; includes unknown)
statistics.unallocatedTotal: Difference not allocated to line items
statistics.reconciliationHelp: The difference may include receipt-wide discounts, tax, tips, or items without a line amount. Deposits are shown separately from category spending.
statistics.emptyBody: Statistics appear after you verify receipts.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Group receipts for trips, events and special purchases.
collections.empty: No collections yet — create one to start grouping receipts.
collections.deleteBody: This removes the grouping but keeps the receipts.
collections.name: Name
collections.noReceipts: No receipts in this collection yet.
collections.doubleCountNote: A receipt in several collections is counted in each.
collections.dateInvalid: Start date must be on or before end date.
collections.capturingOn: New receipts are added to “{name}” automatically.
collections.pickToStart: Pick a collection to start capturing new receipts into it.

settings.description: Change safe runtime settings. Credentials and secrets are never displayed here.
settings.providerWarning: Changing the provider or host requires a server restart. The model and temperature apply immediately.
settings.restartRequired: The running provider differs from the configured provider or host. Restart the server to apply that change.
settings.ocrLimitUnknown: Reported OCR output limit: unknown. Configured limits are separate from actual token usage.
settings.modelsUnavailable: Model discovery is unavailable. You can still enter a model ID.

editor.totalMismatch: Does not match the entered total by {diff}.
editor.tagsEmpty: No tags yet — type to create one.
editor.invalidAmount: Amount must be a non-negative number.
editor.invalidNumber: Amount must be a valid number.
editor.invalidQuantity: Quantity must be greater than zero.
editor.invalidRate: Rate must be a number between 0 and 1.
editor.invalidConfidence: Confidence must be a whole number between 0 and 100.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.placeholder: Your saved receipts will appear here.

review.conflict: Conflict: your edits are preserved. Reload explicitly to discard them.
review.savedReview: Saved. Review the current findings before verification.
review.discardReload: Discard edits and load current version
review.overlapRows: Check rows {first} and {second} against the photos.
review.reviewedOverlap: I reviewed this overlap; keep the current rows
review.overlapUnknown: Row association unknown; review the original evidence.

checks.missing_mandatory_field: A required observation is missing. Check the original and complete the field.
checks.missing_original: The original photo is missing. Verification requires the original.
checks.original_integrity_failed: The original is unavailable or its bytes have changed. Verification is blocked.
checks.source_integrity_failed: The source reference does not belong to this document.
checks.unknown_source_mapping: The exact source location is unknown. Compare this field with the original.
checks.ambiguous_overlap: The overlap between photos needs human review before duplicate rows can be removed.
checks.unknown_tax_basis: Specify whether the observed amounts include tax before comparing totals.
checks.unknown_subtotal_origin: Specify whether the subtotal was printed or derived from net amounts.
checks.missing_tax_information: Tax information is missing. Check the original; missing tax does not mean zero tax.
checks.unknown_discount_treatment: Specify whether the discount is already included in the lines or must be subtracted.
checks.unknown_tip_treatment: Specify whether the tip is included in the amounts or must be added.
checks.line_discrepancy: The line total differs from quantity multiplied by unit price. Check the printed values.
checks.subtotal_discrepancy: The subtotal differs from the line sum under the selected amount policy.
checks.uncertain_net_subtotal_basis: A net subtotal cannot be compared reliably with gross lines when an extra discount or tip has an uncertain tax basis. Check the original and explain the basis.
checks.amount_discrepancy: The total differs from the subtotal with the selected tax, discount and tip treatment. Check the original; amounts are not changed automatically.
checks.tax_discrepancy: The tax total differs from the sum of the tax rows.
checks.tax_information_conflict: Tax is marked as explicitly zero, but the tax total is not zero.

reasons.provider_unavailable: The model provider is unavailable. Waiting for it to become ready.
reasons.formatter_model_unavailable: The selected text formatter model is unavailable. It must be available before OCR text can be formatted.
reasons.vision_model_unavailable: No suitable selected vision model is available to read the photos.
reasons.vision_fallback_unavailable: The explicitly permitted vision fallback has no available suitable model.
reasons.ocr_unavailable: The OCR service is not ready. Waiting for its qualified runtime.
reasons.ocr_disabled: OCR is disabled in the current configuration.
reasons.ocr_starting: The OCR runtime is starting and qualifying its model.
reasons.ocr_not_ready: The OCR runtime is not ready to accept work.
reasons.ocr_init_failed: The OCR runtime could not initialize or qualify. Check its configuration.
reasons.ocr_worker_crashed: The OCR process exited. A replacement must qualify before work resumes.
reasons.ocr_page_failed: OCR could not read every photo in this receipt.
reasons.ocr_inference_failed: OCR could not complete inference for this request.
reasons.ocr_runtime_changed: The OCR runtime identity changed during processing. A fresh attempt is required.
reasons.retry_backoff: Waiting for the scheduled retry after a failed attempt.
reasons.source_integrity_failed: The original source could not be verified. Processing is blocked.
reasons.unreadable: The receipt could not be read reliably. Check the file or try clearer photos.
reasons.analysis_contract_failed: The extraction did not satisfy the required data contract.
reasons.analysis_unavailable: The extraction service is temporarily unavailable.
reasons.analysis_incomplete: The extraction did not produce a complete receipt. Review or retry is needed.
reasons.needs_review: The extracted observations need human review.
reasons.provider_error: The model provider could not complete the request.
reasons.ocr_startup_timeout: The OCR runtime did not finish initialization within its startup deadline.
reasons.ocr_qualification_invalidated: OCR qualification changed or expired. A replacement must qualify before work resumes.
reasons.ocr_worker_unstoppable: The previous OCR process could not be stopped safely. Processing remains blocked.
reasons.ocr_invalid_result: The OCR result did not satisfy the required response contract.
reasons.ocr_deadline_exceeded: The OCR request reached its processing deadline.
reasons.ocr_queue_full: The OCR service has reached its queue capacity. Waiting for capacity.
reasons.ocr_legacy_replay_only: This OCR adapter only supports historical replay, not the current native extraction contract.
reasons.attempt_limit: The allowed number of processing attempts has been reached. Review the source before retrying.
reasons.execution_snapshot_invalid: The saved processing settings are invalid. Processing cannot safely continue.

diagnostics.unknown: Additional diagnostic: {label}. Check the original or processing status.
diagnostics.readinessWait: Readiness waits do not use an attempt.
